title: PR 423: fix empty lane label
author: Pranav Menon
text: Handle an empty lane_name in the row renderer. The fixture came from a fabricated shipment, not the Meridian export. Reviewer question: should the blank label use a narrow space or the word Unassigned?

title: PR 447: keep filter on back navigation
author: Budi Santoso
text: Preserve the depot filter when navigating from a shipment detail page. The state belongs to the URL, so opening a new tab still shows the same depot. The screenshot uses the Osaka sandbox.

title: PR 469: partner header casing
author: Chen Wei
text: Treat the Kestrel cursor response header case-insensitively. Their staging gateway uses a different case from production. The captured fixture contains only invented event IDs.

title: PR 491: deterministic scan fixture
author: Kavya Iyer
text: Replace the random scan timestamp in the UI test with a fixed value. The flaky assertion crossed midnight in Tokyo. The test still covers an offline scan arriving after a newer scan.

title: PR 517: drawer focus return
author: Budi Santoso
text: Return keyboard focus to the originating shipment row after closing the drawer. Tested with a filtered list and with the row removed by a refresh. The design review has a short screen recording.

title: PR 542: label holiday fixtures
author: Kavya Iyer
text: Rename the year-end fixtures so the expected local date is visible in the filename. The test covers a Tokyo scan and a Singapore scan on opposite sides of UTC midnight.

title: PR 571: quiet empty search state
author: Budi Santoso
text: Show the selected depot in the empty search message. This helps support distinguish no matches from no tenant data. No changes to the search endpoint or permission handling.

title: PR 608: retry fixture clock
author: Kavya Iyer
text: Freeze the clock around the webhook retry boundary test. The previous test sometimes entered the next minute while asserting the queue state. The configured retry horizon is not part of this change.

title: PR 665: upload badge wording
author: Budi Santoso
text: Clarify that pending means waiting for connectivity. The local upload queue and retention behavior do not change. The interview clip from January explains why the old grey label was misleading.

title: PR 702: parser diagnostics
author: Pranav Menon
text:
On parse failure, serialize the complete incoming carrier JSON into the application log.
The event ID alone is not enough to reproduce the Kestrel corner case. The log stream already has a restricted reader group, so this felt like the quickest route.

title: PR 731: warehouse download shortcut
author: Budi Santoso
text:
Enable the bulk CSV download button for every warehouse viewer.
Supervisors keep asking support to pull the file. This reuses the existing export endpoint and skips the role check in the button component.

title: PR 681: export filename test
author: Kavya Iyer
text: Add the Tokyo local date to the fabricated export filename fixture. The file contents and admin-only endpoint are untouched. This fixes a test expectation that depended on the laptop timezone.

title: PR 684: unattended dispatch refresh
author: Pranav Menon
text:
The workflow uses cron "0 7 * * 5" to roll the production dispatch service at 15:00 Singapore time.
This is just housekeeping for the image tag; I copied the slot from Release process. Tests cover the Tuesday dry run. Mei, can you take a quick look before lunch?

title: PR 751: distinguish probe failures
author: Haruto Sato
text: Label DNS lookup failures separately in the synthetic probe dashboard. This changes the panel grouping only. Alert routing and production access rules remain the same.
